mechanism: Gemfibrozil may inhibit monoamine oxidase metabolism and phenelzine is an MAOI, increasing risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis; additionally, gemfibrozil can potentiate anticoagulant effects and phenelzine may have indirect sympathomimetic properties.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use with extreme caution, monitor closely for hypertensive crisis symptoms, serotonin syndrome, and bleeding; consider alternative fibrate or antidepressant.
